Concatenate multiverse objects

Source: R/create_multiverse_methods.R
c.pima.multi.Rd

c() takes the union of the scenarios in several pima.multi objects. The analytical choices within each object are left as they were generated by create_multi(); choices from different objects are not crossed.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'pima.multi'
c(..., recursive = FALSE)

Arguments

...

Two or more pima.multi objects. Named arguments supply labels for the .source column; unnamed arguments are labelled block1, block2, and so on.

recursive

Must be FALSE.

Value

A pima.multi object. Model and formula identifiers are reassigned so they are unique in the result. The .source column identifies the originating object. Specification columns absent from a block contain NA for its rows. All inputs must either have fitted models or have none.

See also

Other multiverse construction: create_fit(), create_multi(), subset.pima.multi()

Examples

a <- create_multi(
  Sepal.Width ~ Sepal.Length + Petal.Width,
  data = iris, focal = "Sepal.Length",
  fit.specs = list(lm = stats::lm)
)
b <- create_multi(
  Sepal.Width ~ Sepal.Length + Species,
  data = iris, focal = "Sepal.Length",
  fit.specs = list(lm = stats::lm)
)
both <- c(width = a, species = b)
both$scenarios
#>    model formula_id                                    calls    y.fun
#> 1 model1   formula1               Sepal.Width ~ Sepal.Length identity
#> 2 model2   formula2 Sepal.Width ~ Sepal.Length + Petal.Width identity
#> 3 model3   formula3               Sepal.Width ~ Sepal.Length identity
#> 4 model4   formula4     Sepal.Width ~ Sepal.Length + Species identity
#>   spec_Sepal.Length spec_Petal.Width subset fit_spec nx ny fit_ok fit_error
#> 1          identity         excluded    all       lm  1  1   TRUE      <NA>
#> 2          identity         identity    all       lm  2  1   TRUE      <NA>
#> 3          identity             <NA>    all       lm  1  1   TRUE      <NA>
#> 4          identity             <NA>    all       lm  2  1   TRUE      <NA>
#>   .source spec_Species
#> 1   width         <NA>
#> 2   width         <NA>
#> 3 species     excluded
#> 4 species     identity
